entries.name: L2B.SUM
entries.note: Vector of numbers to its sum (0 for empty).

entries.name: G0C.MAXV
entries.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
entries.note: Largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

entries.name: L2A.ORDERS
entries.note: JSON String with an orders array -> Vector of order Records

entries.name: L2A.MOD
entries.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
entries.note: a b -> a - b * floor(a/b); lifts over a Vector in either operand

entries.name: L2B.MEAN
entries.body: 'ZV' BIND ZV L2B.SUM ZV LENGTH DIV
entries.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector, a bare scalar.

entries.name: L1D.WHERE
entries.body: 'WT' BIND 0 WT LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'WI' BIND WT WI GET ] FILTER
entries.note: non-empty Vector of truths -> Vector of the indices holding TRUE

entries.name: L2C.REV
entries.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'ORD' BIND ORD 'qty' GET ORD 'price' GET MUL ] MAP L2B.SUM
entries.note: Total of qty times price over the orders that have a price.
